claims.claim: FULL/AGENT installation incorrectly converted the optional LM Studio context proxy into a mandatory write-start gate, blocking directly selected Qwen even though agent write authority remained enabled.

evidence.observation: The installer previously emitted MCP_REQUIRE_CONTEXT_COMPACTOR_ACTIVE=1 whenever FULL/AGENT included the plugin.
Strict proxy telemetry was evaluated before task_start and returned CONTEXT_COMPACTOR_NOT_ACTIVE.
Regression tests prove advisory direct-model startup, explicit LM Studio strict blocking, and non-LM-Studio frontend bypass.

counterEvidence.observation: Node write authority remained enabled; the failure was not SAFE mode or filesystem permission.

claims.claim: Recoverable task authorization and phase-budget responses were overwritten with stopCurrentWorkflow=true, encouraging the chat model to abandon implementation and emit manual code.

evidence.observation: Recovery is now classified separately from same-call retry and terminal integrity failure.
RAG routing no longer overwrites checkpoint/gate recovery with a hard stop.
A fabricated t1/tok_t1 authorization returns TASK_AUTH_INVALID_FORMAT and a server-issued unreal_agent_plan recovery without writing.

counterEvidence.observation: Corrupt task-state integrity failures remain terminal and fail closed.

claims.claim: Tail-only Unreal log reads could omit the original error in oversized logs.

evidence.observation: Range reads now return byte cursors, hasMore, and truncation state.
The API now supports tail, first_error from byte zero, and cursor/range modes.
Subprocess coverage proves an original error before a large noisy tail is found by first_error while range cursors remain stable.

claims.claim: Context-compactor files were bounded per session but session directories had no global retention policy.

evidence.observation: Daily bounded GC applies 90-day completed/inactive and 30-day cancelled retention, excludes current/active sessions, and preserves corrupt artifacts.
Tests verify old completed/cancelled/inactive sessions are deleted and active/corrupt sessions remain.

claims.claim: Pinned runtime metadata was secure at download time but version, URL, platform, architecture, checksum, and executable probes lacked one validated maintenance contract.

evidence.observation: One manifest now defines Python/uv/Node/PowerShell versions, HTTPS templates, 18 platform/architecture assets, SHA-256 values, and probes.
The maintenance CLI validates/list assets and prevalidates checksum updates before atomic replacement.
Matrix/probe/url coverage is regression tested.

claims.claim: When workspace.json was absent or copied across operating systems, the shared index resolver could preserve foreign separators or a stale root and point LM Studio at a non-existent RAG database.

evidence.observation: Portable slash styles are normalized for the current host and non-existent roots copied from another machine fall back to the discovered workspace.
Fresh macOS/Linux-style workspaces resolve to data/unreal58/rag.sqlite instead of a literal backslash filename.
A Windows-style portable relative path resolves to native path components on the current host.

counterEvidence.observation: The primary Python installer already constructed native paths directly; the defect affected shared resolver and repair flows.

claims.claim: The integrated --build-rag pipeline omitted project guidelines and game-design inputs, so a successfully built index could lack the compile, Blueprint, and project-profile continuity documents expected by retrieval policy.

evidence.observation: The integrated pipeline now collects raw_guidelines.jsonl and raw_game_design.jsonl before every index build, while active project profiles remain part of standard/full collection.
The installer pipeline contract requires both portable document collectors to run before the build stage.
The rebuilt live index ranks all four stabilized guideline/profile cases in the required top-five window.

counterEvidence.observation: The legacy explicit rag.ps1 build route already collected guideline and game-design inputs; the omission was specific to the consolidated installer pipeline.
